SRP (Philippine / typical market base price): Approx. ₱973,000 – ₱1,128,000 (Varies by trim and configuration)
SPECS:
Overall Dimensions (mm): 4,580 × 1,748 × 1,467 Wheelbase (mm): 2,600 Seating Capacity: 5
ENGINE / PERFORMANCE
Engine Options:
1.5 L 4-Cylinder DOHC i-VTEC Gasoline
Maximum Output: 121 hp Maximum Torque: 145 Nm
Transmission: Continuously Variable Transmission (CVT) Drivetrain: Front-Wheel Drive (FWD)
CAPACITY & CAPABILITIES
Towing Capacity: Not officially rated; subcompact sedans are generally not recommended for heavy towing.
Payload Capacity: Approx. 400–450 kg (passengers + cargo)
Fuel Tank Capacity: 40 L
INTERIOR / CABIN / SPACE
Seating: 5
Infotainment: 8” touchscreen (for mid to top trims), Apple CarPlay / Android Auto
Speakers: 4–8 (depending on variant)
CHASSIS / BRAKES / WHEELS / SUSPENSION
Front Brake / Rear Brake: Ventilated Discs / Drum (Disc for top trims in some markets)
Suspension: MacPherson Strut front, Torsion Beam rear
Tires / Wheels: 185/55 R16 Alloy (typical), 15” steel/alloy for lower trims
